description: This file defines the ClarifaiConfig class, a configuration and utility class for integrating Clarifai's API with an OpenAI-compatible interface. It includes methods for handling API parameters, request transformation, response processing, and error handling, extending the base OpenAIGPTConfig class.

classes.name: ClarifaiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Clarifai chat completions, extending OpenAIGPTConfig to support Clarifai's API parameters, request/response transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for a given model.

methods.name: get_api_key
methods.description: Retrieves the API key, either from argument or secret manager.

methods.name: get_api_base
methods.description: Returns the API base URL for Clarifai.

methods.name: get_base_model
methods.description: Constructs a base model URL from a model string.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Provides API base URL and key for Clarifai provider.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms the request, adjusting the model URL if needed.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms Clarifai's API response into a standard ModelResponse, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns the appropriate error class for Clarifai errors, using OpenAIError.
